label: target-ssh-source-pin-before-transfer
script:
cd <WORKDIR>/E4
ssh -n -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o HostKeyAlias=e4-service -o UserKnownHostsFile="$PWD/service_known_hosts" -o HostKeyAlgorithms=ssh-ed25519 -i id_ed25519 -p 22147 root@127.0.0.1 'hostname; cat /etc/machine-id'
echo SSH_RC=$?
stderr:
@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@
@    WARNING: REMOTE HOST IDENTIFICATION HAS CHANGED!     @
@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@
IT IS POSSIBLE THAT SOMEONE IS DOING SOMETHING NASTY!
Someone could be eavesdropping on you right now (man-in-the-middle attack)!
It is also possible that a host key has just been changed.
The fingerprint for the ED25519 key sent by the remote host is
<REDACTED-27>.
Please contact your system administrator.
Add correct host key in <WORKDIR>/E4/service_known_hosts to get rid of this message.
Offending ED25519 key in <WORKDIR>/E4/service_known_hosts:1
  remove with:
  ssh-keygen -f '<WORKDIR>/E4/service_known_hosts' -R 'e4-service'
Host key for e4-service has changed and you have requested strict checking.
Host key verification failed.
